title: Cold rebuild: Configure it fluently
summary: Rebuild Configure it fluently from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Configure it fluently** in *Data annotations and the Fluent API*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

code: protected override void OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder options) => options.UseSqlite("Data Source=library.db");
steps.explain: The annotation set 50, then `OnModelCreating` set 120: the Fluent API is applied last, so it wins. The column name came only from the annotation, so it stays `name`. `db.Model` is the model EF Core built, and you can inspect it like this.
